title: Synchronic Studio
summary: A local-first creative practice system that helps artists see the thread connecting their daily work.
intro: Synchronic brings practice sessions, reflections, excursions, tasks, and gentle guidance into one private workspace built around the rhythms of an artist’s life.

heroImage.alt: Synchronic landing page with a dark studio-inspired interface and central invitation for artists

designSystem.name: Synchronic Studio
designSystem.summary: A calm studio system that combines warm editorial surfaces with precise, accessible interaction across five distinct creative practices.

principles.name: Warm, never washed out
principles.description: Paper-like quiet supports attention without weakening hierarchy.

principles.name: Color has a job
principles.description: Purple carries brand and interaction while pillar colors identify domains with non-color cues.

principles.name: Calm is functional
principles.description: Rhythm, restraint, and reduced motion help creative work remain the focus.

principles.name: Editorial voice, practical operation
principles.description: Serif type marks identity and reflection while sans serif supports controls, labels, and reading.

principles.name: One system, distinct practices
principles.description: Shared foundations keep Reflect, Practice, Roam, Tend, and Observe coherent without erasing their roles.

typography.description: Carries identity, display hierarchy, and reflective moments.
Supports controls, labels, navigation, and sustained interface reading.

components.name: Button
components.description: Shared actions adapt to theme and optional practice accent while preserving native semantics.

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Binary preferences pair a native checkbox with a visible state label.

components.name: Image uploader
components.description: A resilient media flow communicates progress and recovery with text as well as color.

productProof.title: Five practices, one interaction grammar
productProof.description: Each practice rebinds the semantic accent to its domain color while shared navigation, controls, forms, and state behavior remain consistent.

accessibility.title: Contrast-safe semantics and visible focus
accessibility.description: Light and dark roles, three-pixel focus treatment, text-backed status, reduced motion, and 44px minimum targets are encoded as system foundations.
